scope: Previously assessed development inputs; one supplied family, active destinations and partition. Necessary conditional precision qualification before open candidate investment, not complete-method confirmation.
reason_for_new_definition: V4 fixed-step corrected-risk branch stopped. V5 fits a distinct fixed overidentified whole-product moment square with a positive square Gram, rather than repeating V4 updates.
common_moments: 25 fixed anchors per condition and destination: constant, nine three-field base columns, nine family centers and six parameter-box axis anchors. Physical reference units T=1000, O=1, D=0.5; no outcome-selected anchors or random moment pruning.
fixed_weight: Identity in the declared common moment coordinates; not an optimal covariance or likelihood, and not a claim of independent weak moments.
noise: Reuse saved V3-R1 observed-training-RMS sigma proxy, independent additive Gaussian raw node/field errors with no acquisition clipping; whole-product correction includes curvature and cross derivatives.
training_split: Exactly the frozen V3-R1 six training and two heldout conditions; scale hash asserted before execution.

preflight.points: First fixed seed, all three roles, without accuracy or truth selection
preflight.meaning: Numerical eligibility only; not a parameter precision or information-optimality gate

scoring: Seal all 36 attempts before grading; preserve incomplete/budget fits in the denominator. Reuse old V1 grades, never rescore old estimates. Grade actual parameters with original 12/18/18/25 percent gates, bases separate.
stopping: One fixed preflight and one fixed paired batch only. On failure preserve results; no anchor/weight/noise/start/radius search, no extra blocks, no open confirmation or engineering confirmation using this version.
